focused-edge.name: focused-edge
command: --test-name-pattern=^Dogongiyos cannot offer|^Carol trigger cannot|^Carol checks loss|^Carol actual discards used|^Grandcross two active

reason: Full Dogongiyos two-card optional summon discard/slayer/double break/all-origin opposing mana tap; Carol actual discard conditional self deployment; Grandcross Samurai Generate and any own crossgear entry optional opposing Blocker destruction.
validationNotes: Start and verification nameKey counts from actual dist/cards.json are9336 and9339. Baseline4343eb00 inspected with clean working/staged state and no prior batch process remaining. Existing definitions, IDs, catalogue, image references and save formats preserved.

Full official faces/basic information, printed mana and current restrictions checked for three originals and two exact-name reprints; all five images viewed. Grandcross promo is low resolution; full official HTML agrees with the readable original image. Night Carol and Carol live spell are different cards and not added or counted.

Dogongiyos generalizes the existing discard-summon reduction to two distinct physical hand cards, reserved before committing the whole discard batch. It rejects insufficient hand and duplicate/self selection, supports decline/cancel, normal and manual mana, JSON/encrypted continuation, and actual Diamond Star reduction prohibition. Slayer/double break and all-origin opposing mana tap use native processing.

Exact official QA34350 reproduced in both seats with two registered Night Carols returning to hand by their replacement while the summon still costs three. Ordinary actual discards and actual Jashin replacement discards trigger new Carol, whereas replacing a discard to mana does not.

Carol checks visible Water/Fire mana and absence of any own named Carol when its trigger resolves. One multicolor mana suffices; face-down identities do not. Both effect controllers, multiple queued copies, ignored/sealed/other-owner names, changing mana/source conditions, declined deployment, and moved grave identities verified.

Grandcross uses native Samurai Generate and watches every own crossgear entry, including non-executed grave/deck deployment. Optional enemy Blocker destruction is independent for multiple active copies, ignores suppressed sources, and does not trigger on crossing, enemy gear or unrelated entries.

82 focused tests and173 affected regressions pass, total255. One legal forty-card game preserves all80 physical IDs and serialized legal actions. Check, audit/nameKey, campaign verifier and baseline invariants pass. No whole npm test or historical long group rerun.

The extra Fly/Dogongiyos test initially reversed the expected mana owner. With Dogongiyos on the opposite side, the active player mana is tapped and Dogongiyos owner mana remains untapped. Corrected expectations pass in both seats; no runtime fix was needed. All other focused/related tests passed on first runs.

T2 Ogapu held under exact QA35756: only normal Castle fortification triggers, and G-castle placement or ordinary shield addition does not. No normal Castle is registered; do not claim partial support or alter save formats to count it. Historical individual/long/reprint deferrals remain unchanged. No push/publication/Netlify update.
